cause_findings.finding: The 121 requested rows are present exactly once, are sorted, and are all external-only noncanonical rows.
The range contains 88 allowlist-identified rows and 33 rows with explicit unknown identity; no DLL or name was inferred for the 33 unknown rows.
The committed xref export contains 260 unique matching external reference rows across 88 entries; 33 selected entries have no matching xref row.

The source row field external_xref_count is zero for all 121 rows, while the committed xref export yields nonzero derived counts for 88 rows; the artifact preserves both values and treats the export as the derived count.

Function body size, section/block, thunk, stub, and generated classification remain unavailable for every row because the committed external-only reconciliation records those fields as null or absent.
All rows are external import/runtime manager entries by location and committed xref type; no gameplay semantics are claimed for named external APIs.
